name: agend-sh
description: Persistent Linux environments for AI agents, with interactive terminals and HTTPS previews.
long_description: Run commands, drive REPLs and terminal apps, edit files, collect background task output, and expose development servers through HTTPS previews. This bundle launches the published Agend CLI image locally through Docker. Requires Docker with Linux containers, Node.js 20+, an Agend account, and available environment quota. Register for a free seven-day account at https://agend.sh/account?signup=1, then authenticate with agend login and supply your account token. Interactive input_wait results describe observed terminal input-wait events, not application readiness. Local file transfers use the container's /workspace; host directories are not mounted automatically.

api_token.title: Agend account token
api_token.description: Sign in with agend login, then load your active account token as described at https://github.com/agend-sh/cli/blob/main/docs/mcp-registry.md#connect-using-the-container. An Agend account and available environment quota are required. Refresh this value when the token expires.
